author: vladthegreat100
body:
There is non-avicus server content being shown on the post, and according to section D, rule 7, stating that any text that is considered advertising, where she is reviewing the server as one of the "best multiplayer servers" with the following servers:

- MCGamer Network
- MC Central

I'm not asking to delete the thread but to redact the two videos of MC Central and the one video of MCGamer being advertised as well as warn her for future reference so she knows its against the rules.

The thread: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/ca20488ac

Thanks,
Vlad
